raw.query:
WITH lang_configs AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS count,
         round(min(mean_ttft_ms)::numeric, 1) AS min_mean_ttft, round(max(mean_ttft_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_mean_ttft,
         round(min(mean_itl_ms)::numeric, 1) AS min_mean_itl, round(max(mean_itl_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_mean_itl,
         round(min(p99_ttft_ms)::numeric, 1) AS min_p99_ttft, round(max(p99_ttft_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_p99_ttft
  FROM provenance.runs r 
  JOIN provenance.llm_run_summary l USING (run_id)
  WHERE r.experiment='reactive' AND r.pool='language' AND r.is_current
    AND l.mean_ttft_ms < 500 AND l.mean_itl_ms < 50 AND l.p99_ttft_ms > 1000
),
riders_data AS (
  SELECT round(min(gpu_hours)::numeric, 2) AS min_gpu, round(max(gpu_hours)::numeric, 2) AS max_gpu,
         round(min(p99_ms)::numeric, 1) AS min_p99, round(max(p99_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_p99
  FROM provenance.v_pool_cost c
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l USING (run_id)
  WHERE c.experiment = 'riders' AND c.run_id LIKE 'riders:ladder%' AND c.is_current AND l.sla_metric='ttft' AND l.is_current
),
enc_fast_onset AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS count,
         round(min(achieved_p99_ms)::numeric, 1) AS min_p99_delay, round(max(achieved_p99_ms)::numeric, 1) AS max_p99_delay,
         bool_and(is_violation) AS all_violate
  FROM provenance.v_infraction 
  WHERE pool='encoder' AND policy='reactive' AND is_current 
    AND window_name IN ('burst3', 'burst6') AND lead_s = 300
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT count FROM lang_configs) AS lang_configs_count,
  (SELECT '(' || min_mean_ttft || '-' || max_mean_ttft || 'ms mean TTFT, ' || min_mean_itl || '-' || max_mean_itl || 'ms mean ITL, ' || min_p99_ttft || '-' || max_p99_ttft || 'ms p99 TTFT)' FROM lang_configs) AS lang_ranges,
  (SELECT 'spend: ' || min_gpu || ' to ' || max_gpu || ' GPU-h, p99 TTFT: ' || min_p99 || ' to ' || max_p99 || ' ms' FROM riders_data) AS riders_ladder,
  (SELECT 'count: ' || count || ', all_violate: ' || all_violate || ', p99_delay: ' || min_p99_delay || '-' || max_p99_delay || ' ms' FROM enc_fast_onset) AS enc_loses;
